## Key Concepts

### APA Results Reporting
- **Statistical notation**: Italicise test statistics (e.g., *t*, *r*, *F*)
- **Exact p-values**: Report to three decimal places (e.g., *p* = .023)
- **Effect sizes**: Always report alongside test statistics
- **Confidence intervals**: Include 95% CIs where appropriate

### MCQ Feedback Focus Areas
- Common misconceptions from the in-class test
- Areas requiring further revision
- Strategies for the research report

### Data Collection
- Standardised procedures across group members
- Data quality checks during collection
- Ethical conduct with participants
